defects.justification: The disk cache never evicts and requests are unauthenticated: each request can write up to 10 new thumbnails per distinct image, so any client can fill the disk by posting slightly different images (acknowledged in README).
The early size check only uses Content-Length; a chunked upload without that header is fully buffered by Rack before file.size is checked at line 261, so request size is not actually bounded.
Only per-read open/read timeouts are set; there is no overall deadline on the remote download, so a server trickling bytes just under the read timeout can hold a request thread for a very long time.
